annotations.title: Email HTML: clipping, links and pixels

description: Read an email's HTML. Returns its size against Gmail's ~102 KB clipping limit with what is taking the room, every link and image host, tracking pixels, URL shorteners, and each linked domain checked against SURBL. Parsed inertly: nothing loads, no pixel fires, no link is followed. The SURBL lookups count against the daily free limit; set scan to false to skip them.

html.description: The full HTML of the email.

scan.description: Check the linked domains against SURBL. Defaults to true.
